t: man, I'm really hungry today. I hope we got food in the storage
my stomach's been growling since I woke up
I keep thinking about supper and it's not even midday
if there's nothing in the stores tonight I'm going to be miserable
I'd eat just about anything right now, honestly
skipped a meal yesterday and I'm feeling it now
hungry and fishing all day. the fish get to eat better than I do
picking berries all day and I'm not supposed to eat any? come on
hard to aim a spear when your stomach won't shut up
swinging an axe on an empty stomach is a good way to lose a foot
I am so tired. I just want to lie down for a bit
my feet are killing me today
I could fall asleep standing up, I swear
one more haul and then I'm done, I mean it this time
worn out and still no bed of my own to fall into. that's the worst part
this arm's not right. I should get it looked at
everything aches. I'm too old for whatever that was
still sleeping on the ground. somebody build a house already
a roof. that's all I want. four walls and a roof
I hear them hammering all day but I still sleep in the dirt
my back is one big knot from sleeping outside
when I finally get a bed I'm not leaving it for two days
it's a good little house. I keep stopping to look at it
I should sweep the floor when I get home. it's getting bad
nothing like shutting your own door at the end of the day
I wonder what my better half is up to right now
I should bring something home tonight. it's been a while since I did
we should sit by the water some evening, the two of us. been ages
the god's been good to us lately. I should say so more often
I felt watched today. not in a bad way. just watched
whatever's up there, it put the fish in the water, and that'll do for me
signs and wonders. or weather. hard to say which
everyone keeps talking about the god this, the god that. I just work
long day. they're all long days lately
I should fix my boots before the cold comes
that cloud looks like a boar. no, a bear. no, a boar
I had a dream about my mother last night. strange how that comes back
somebody's been moving my things. I know exactly where I left that basket
I wonder what's past the far hills. someone should go look
the days go by fast when your hands are busy
I could go for a swim. maybe when the work's done
half the village snores. you can hear it from the fire
soup again tonight, probably. it's always soup
the water was good to me today. can't complain
one of these days I'm pulling up something huge. I can feel it
these bushes are nearly picked clean. we need to range farther
you learn where everything grows, doing this. every bush for a mile
saw tracks this morning. something big came through in the night
a clean kill and a full larder. that's a good day
that beam went up straight and true. I do good work, I don't care who hears it
measure it twice. every time. that's the whole secret
this forest could keep me busy for a lifetime
you can tell a good tree by the sound it makes when you knock it
good stone today. splits right where you ask it to
my hands are all dust and I've stopped minding
the field doesn't care how you feel. it wants water either way
quiet on the walls today. quiet is good. I like quiet
everyone's hurt until they're hungry, then everyone's healed. funny how that works
please just let the stores hold out through the season
keep an eye on the little ones. that's all I ask
thank you for today. it was a hard one but we got through
if you're listening, we could use a dry week
watch over the ones sleeping outside tonight
give me a roof before winter. I'm not asking for much
footing to roof, all of it mine. I like knowing the whole of a thing
my hands are all dust and splinters and I'm not complaining
I should check the stores before I get too hopeful about dinner
I keep doing the math on how much food is left. I don't like the answer
one decent meal would fix half my mood right now
I can work hungry, but I can't work stupid. I'm getting close to stupid
if I sit down, I might not get back up today
my legs feel like they belong to somebody older
I need a quiet hour and nobody asking me for anything
I thought I slept, but my body disagrees
that still hurts when I breathe too deep
I keep telling myself it's just a bruise. it better be just a bruise
I'm moving slower today. no point pretending otherwise
sleeping outside makes every morning start badly
I know houses take time. I also know rain does not care
I would trade a lot for a dry blanket tonight
every finished roof makes me happy and a little jealous
I still listen for leaks when it rains, even with a roof over me
having a door changes your whole mood. strange thing, but it does
I should patch that corner before it gets worse
home is small, but it's ours, and that counts
I hope they're eating enough. they always say they are
marriage is mostly remembering what the other person forgot
I should be kinder when I get home tired
I don't need a sign every day. once in a while is enough
I pray because it helps me keep my head straight
maybe the god helps. maybe we help each other and call it that
I want to believe, but wanting is not the same thing
people are quicker to call luck holy when it goes their way
if the god wants trust, making things clearer would help
nets are easy. people are the hard part
if the water is quiet, I start wondering if I'm wasting my time
I found a good patch today. not telling everyone, not yet
berries look simple until you bet dinner on them
the woods feel different when you're the one carrying the spear
I hate wasting a shot. meat is too much work for that
every plank has an opinion. most of them are wrong
good work is mostly fixing the thing you rushed yesterday
trees fall fast. hauling them is the hard part
I can tell which axe is mine by the handle biting my hand
stone is simple. hit it wrong and it lets you know
I come back from the pit with dust in places dust should not be
if the rows are straight, the day feels less messy
plants either grow or they don't. no arguing with that
the pot is never big enough when everyone comes in hungry
people complain less when the food is hot. that's my whole craft
I can bind a cut. I can't make people rest after
half of healing is getting stubborn people to sit down
I know what people want me to say. that doesn't make it true
faith gets louder when the stores get low
every path looks easy until you need to find your way back
I mark trees because I trust trees more than my memory
watch duty is mostly standing still and not acting bored
quiet makes me nervous, but noise is usually worse
please send food before people start turning on each other
I don't need plenty. I just need enough for tonight
if you can hear me, help the ones sleeping outside
keep the rain off us until the roof is done
thank you for the roof. I mean that
look after my family when I can't
give me patience, because I am running out of it
help me not say the thing I'm thinking
I don't know if this is prayer or just talking upward
if you're real, today would be a good day to show it
thank you. I don't know what else to say, so thank you
